title: Karnataka Bus Accident: Midnight Collision With A 'Yama Swaroopi' Container Claims Over 12 Lives | Cities News - News18
text: A horrific bus accident near Hiriyur in Chitradurga district has left more than 12 people feared dead after a sleeper coach bus caught fire following a collision with a container truck. The incident has sent shockwaves across Karnataka, as several passengers were reportedly burnt alive while asleep. The private sleeper coach bus, operated by the S Bird company, was travelling from Bengaluru to Shivamogga. The bus departed Bengaluru around midnight and met with the accident at approximately 2:45 am near Hiriyur. Preliminary information suggests that a container truck coming from the opposite direction rammed into the bus, triggering the devastating crash. According to sources, the impact caused the container truck to hit the bus’s diesel tank. Fire was first noticed in the truck and quickly spread to the bus, which was engulfed in flames within moments. The sudden blaze left little time for passengers to escape. A total of 31 passengers had booked tickets on the bus, and including the driver, 32 people were on board at the time of the accident. Most passengers were asleep when the fire broke out. While around 10 passengers reportedly managed to jump out of the bus, many sustained severe burn injuries. Officials fear that at least 12 passengers may have been burnt alive in the inferno. The injured were rushed to the Chitradurga district hospital for treatment. Rescue operations were carried out immediately, and authorities are continuing investigations to ascertain the exact cause of the collision. Further details are awaited as officials assess the extent of casualties and damage caused by the tragic accident. (Reported by: Manjunath, News18 Kannada, Chitradurga)
